description: Local overrides that belong in unional/renovate-preset once it carries the canonical body.
Without them nothing merges bot PRs here: the preset has no automerge policy, and the
Mergify rules this repo used to rely on asked for a squash merge, which the repo has
disallowed since the merge settings baseline landed — so they had already stopped working.

packageRules.description: Majors break builds in ways CI catches but a human should choose to absorb.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Shortened, not removed: a malicious fix release is exactly what an instant merge would swallow.
